newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Aug producer prices rise 17.6 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Aug producer prices rise 17.6 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly producer price inflation was 17.6 percent in August, down from 33.0 percent in July, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
BULGARIAN PRODUCER PRICES AUG JULY AUG'95
"The rise in producer prices was due to the lev's fall against the dollar and the higher cost of fuels, electricity and flour," an NSI official told Reuters.
The lev fell to 206 per dollar at the end of August from 187 at the beginning of the month as fuel prices rose by an average 23 percent in the same month.

Flour prices surged by 89 percent month-on-month in August as Bulgaria suffered a severe wheat shortage and electricity prices for industry gained five percent after a 110 percent jump the month before, the official said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
